locations.note: Brian hits Gina with his car, takes her to a hospital, then sets a fire in her room so they can escape.
Brian and Gina reach a museum, where its database identifies the crucifix as Hopi; the killers Gustav and Feodor then kill Clive and take them away.
In Hopi country they visit an abandoned mine shaft, a Hopi village with a sacred crypt and Mama Dorita's healing place, where a séance is held.
